title: Nearly 75 lakh names added in draft SSR voters lists in 13 States and UTs
description: These States/UTs saw their combined electorate shrink from 49.6 cr to 45.2 cr post-SIR, but SSR has resulted in a recovery to almost 46 cr in draft SSR list; U.P. has highest number of voters added through SSR, but Goa sees highest growth in percentage terms
